title: A Smile to Remember
description: A local man gazes over the patchwork of Dongchuan Red Land in Yunnan Province, China. The image is part of photographer Catherine Hyland's series, The Future of Farming, which documents the contrast in the region between the rice farmers, many of whom are aging and living in poverty, alongside modern realities like tourists flooding the region and drones taking over farming practices. Hyland writes that the series "questions the economic and environmental possibilities of the rural communities, how it can be represented, and who it is for."
translated_description: 一名当地男子凝视着中国云南省东川红土地上的斑斓景象。这张照片出自摄影师凯瑟琳·海兰的系列作品《农业的未来》，该系列记录了该地区种稻农民（其中许多人年事已高且生活贫困）与游客涌入、无人机接管农耕等现代现实之间的反差。海兰写道，这一系列作品"对农村社区的经济与环境可能性、其呈现方式以及服务对象提出了质疑。"
